note: Primary cells are editorial-operation labels, not authorship labels. Synthetic cases are controlled one-variable probes and are not article prose.

cases.previous: A community can absorb only as much need as its members have free resource to meet.
cases.target: I want a community to take on only as much need as its members have free resource to meet.
cases.next: That is a resource constraint, not a judgment of anyone's worth.

scored.basis: Controlled mutation: first-person want adds no author-specific evidence; generic-agent substitution preserves the proposition.

cases.target: So my childhood was a lot of bouncing around between different communes like Twin Oaks, Acorn, East Wind, Padanaram, Zendik, etc. I was never quite the commune kid; I was the perpetual visitor's kid, which turned out to be rarer and stranger: I got the comparison view.
cases.next: Dozens of experiments, side by side, decades apart.

scored.basis: Autobiographical experience is the evidence; generic-agent substitution destroys the source-specific observation.

cases.previous: You can start building the relationships before you own land.
cases.target: You don't have to know exactly what your future community will look like before finding two or three people to practice with.
cases.next: A living room and a commitment to meet are enough to begin.

scored.basis: Controlled prerequisite-release formula; relation is reusable with slot substitution and is not earned by a mechanism in the passage.

cases.previous: In this example, big decisions are made by the membership rather than by a founder acting alone.
cases.target: Because the membership holds that decision, you don't have to ask the founder's permission before the vote can proceed.
cases.next: The permission follows from the governance rule just stated.

scored.basis: Permission follows from an explicit governance mechanism immediately before; the relation itself depends on that local rule.

cases.previous: The thing that's missing is spiritual community without the cult plumbing: depth work and play that is peer-distributed—held by everyone, owed to no one.
cases.target: That's what the rest of this article is about.

scored.basis: Deleting target loses only an announcement of document scope; following heading remains correctly interpretable.

cases.previous: Every connection to the dominant system—medical, financial, communicative, legal, alimentary, energetic—is a separate decision with real costs in both directions.
cases.target: The hardest coupling is medicine, so look at it directly.
cases.next: Modern medicine is about to get very good—possibly nanobot-and-gene-edit good—and almost everything it offers will require full enrollment in the system.

scored.basis: Target performs a substantive case shift from couplings generally to medicine specifically; it selects which case the following paragraph instantiates.
